text:
Nora (Marketing Ops): Morning  spotted a spike: ~6% of APAC inbound leads unassigned >15m. Mostly webinar signups and gated demos. HubSpot shows enrichment pending.
Evan (RevOps): Yep, vendor profiler returned 429 bursts around 03:05-03:20 UTC and our enrichment worker queued retries. HS assignment rule depends on `buyer_segment` so it never matched.
Sofia (Growth): Affected campaigns: webinar_apac_may + demo-request-ebook. Risk of SDRs contacting wrong segment.
Raj (Sales Ops): Quick mitigation: HS fallback workflow that waits 7m then assigns to `rr-apac-temp` round-robin pool and tags `enrich_pending`. That keeps leads owned.
Evan (RevOps): Pseudorule:
```yaml
trigger: lead.created
wait: 420
if: buyer_segment == null
then:
  - assign_owner: rr-apac-temp
  - add_tag: enrich_pending
  - notify: #sdr-fallback
```
Nora (Marketing Ops): Deploy to staging first. Also add a reconcile job in SF to reassign when `buyer_segment` arrives.
Raj (Sales Ops): I'll accept `rr-apac-temp` as a placeholder owner in SF mapping and run a replay once done. ETA 1h.
Evan (RevOps): Add vendor circuit-breaker + exponential backoff and surface metrics: `hs.enrich.429_rate` and `hs.enrich.latency_p95`. Alert if p95 > 25s.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow 89900 deployed to staging.
Sofia (Growth): I'll update SDR playbook: filter `tag:enrich_pending` and wait for reconcile before standard nurture; quick outreach template for tentative leads provided.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Ops checklist: 1) deploy HS fallback (Evan), 2) SF mapping accept placeholder + reconcile (Raj), 3) vendor CB + alerts (Evan), 4) SDR playbook update (Sofia). Monitor HS query `created_at>now()-24h and owner=null`. If <1% after 24h revert fallback.
Evan (RevOps): Logged post-incident actions: hourly smoothing for enrichment bursts, temporary vendor quota increase, and an e2e smoke test.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Thanks team. Will run the 24h smoke and schedule a 15-min retro after replay results. :thumbsup:
